home.title: JW PubliStudy
home.subtitle: A local desktop foundation for organizing the study of personal publications. In this phase the app prepares navigation, settings, and structure for future features.

import.title: Load publications
import.description: In a later phase you will be able to add and manage the publications you want to study.

search.title: Search sources
search.description: Document search will be added after loading and indexing are available.

study.title: Study with cited answers
study.description: The study area will be prepared for answers with clear references to local sources.

publications.title: Publications
publications.description: Import and manage local publications in PDF or TXT format. This phase stores only files and metadata.
publications.empty: No publications imported. Import a PDF or TXT file to get started.

delete_confirm.title: Delete publication
delete_confirm.message: Do you want to delete "{title}" from the local library?

error.title: Error
error.unsupported_file: The selected file type is not supported. Use a PDF or TXT file.
error.duplicate: This publication has already been imported.
error.import_failed: The publication could not be imported.
error.delete_failed: The publication could not be deleted.
error.rename_failed: The publication could not be renamed.

study.title: Study / Chat
study.placeholder: In the future this area will host a study chat with local AI and citations from publications. This phase does not include chat, models, or AI calls.

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_description: Choose the interface language. The preference is saved locally and applied the next time the app starts.
